You and up to three friends travel through a post-apocalyptic world, collect junk, craft survival devices, and interact with the game through voice chat. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionA dead body in the study. Five people, all with something to hide. The famous inventor Christopher Edward has been brutally murdered in his own home. As Detective Karla Robbins, you take on the case. You question his wife, his secretary, the butler, the maid, and the family doctor. Everyone smiles politely; everyone tells their own version of the night's events. Who is lying? Listen closely, compare statements, and spot the contradictions. Record every piece of evidence in your interactive case file and piece the puzzle together, bit by bit. Sometimes, the crucial clue lies in the very detail you overlooked the first time around. Was it about love, money, or power?
